name: Location card
summary: A place without a third-party map: its name and address over a drawn street pattern with a pin, how far it is, its opening hours and an Open in maps button.
use: when an answer is one place to go: a shop, a clinic, a restaurant or a pick-up point
a11y: An article named by the place; the drawn map is decorative and hidden from screen readers, the address is an address element, and Open in maps is a real button.

use_when: the person asked where something is, and one place with its address and hours answers it
avoid_when: several places to compare or choose from: use result-list
a photo of the place is the point: use image-card
a route with steps or a live map is needed: hand off to a maps app with the Open in maps event

parts.name: map
parts.what: a drawn street pattern in the system's neutral colours with a pin; no map tiles

parts.name: address
parts.what: the street line, then an optional postcode and town line

parts.name: facts
parts.what: how far it is, and when it is open

parts.name: open_maps
parts.what: hands the place to a maps app as an event, never a URL

empty.how: with no distance and no hours the facts list is hidden

loading.how: show it once the place is known; the drawn map needs nothing to load

error.how: if the place cannot be found, say so in text or use error-retry

disabled.how: a disabled or still-loading button turns quiet neutral (secondary text on a subtle fill), still readable at AA

overflow.how: on a phone the map gets taller and the button takes the full width

long_text.how: name, address and facts wrap, also long words
